note: Spec 16 § 6 pre-existing violations, recorded when the check landed (§ 9.4 step 1). The check fails on anything NEW; these are what already existed. 'technical' entries are not § 6 violations — the term is a code identifier or an industry term of art. 'pending-decision' entries ARE genuine violations in live user-facing copy and need a founder or counsel call; a build step must not silently rewrite securities-adjacent or brand copy. AC 16 is not met until every pending-decision entry is gone.

entries.reason: 'Solcast Sky Oracle' rendered on the PUBLIC backtest report page. Line 789 reads 'the Solcast Sky Oracle provides reliable telemetry verification suitable for securities yield calculations' — the exact claim § 6 prohibits the word for, on a page a prospective investor can reach without logging in. Highest-priority instance.
entries.decision: Rename the product in user-facing copy, or record a counsel-cleared exception.

entries.reason: 'Patent-pending' as a feature-card title on the public landing page. § 6 prohibits it outright. Either an application is on file and counsel has cleared the wording, or this comes out.
entries.decision: Confirm filing status with counsel, then keep with cleared wording or remove.

"EcoXchange's patent-pending verification engine" inside a generated report footer. AC 16 names PDF templates explicitly, and this string ships inside a document handed to a developer or investor.
entries.decision: Follows the landing.tsx decision; the § 6 approved substitute is 'proprietary verification engine'.
